stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : au moins 11 morts dont 3 enfants dans des frappes russes sur Zaporijjia

en.title: War in Ukraine: at least 11 dead including 3 children in Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: Russian military strikes in Ukraine have killed at least 11 people including 3 children in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine and the United States held constructive discussions in Florida.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Gabriel Attal, Jean-Luc Mélenchon... La mobilisation lycéenne et la jeunesse au programme des grands meetings politiques du week-end

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Gabriel Attal, Jean-Luc Mélenchon... Student mobilization and youth on the agenda of major political rallies this weekend
en.summary: Political candidates are addressing youth and education issues during major campaign rallies this weekend, with student activism featuring prominently in their speeches.

stories.title: Ukraine : des frappes russes sur des quartiers résidentiels de Zaporijia font au moins 11 morts, dont 3 enfants

en.title: Ukraine: Russian strikes on residential areas of Zaporizhzhia kill at least 11, including 3 children
en.summary: Russian airstrikes have struck residential quarters in the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, resulting in at least 11 deaths including 3 children.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : le bilan continue de s’alourdir à Zaporijia après des bombardements russes

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: death toll continues to rise in Zaporizhzhia following Russian bombardments
en.summary: At least 11 people, including 3 children, were killed in Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia on Saturday morning, with rescue operations ongoing to search for survivors under collapsed buildings.

stories.title: Retour sur Terre de Sophie Adenot : "J'ai traversé tout le spectre des émotions humaines", déclare l'astronaute française, arrivée en Europe

en.title: French astronaut Sophie Adenot returns to Earth: "I experienced the full spectrum of human emotions", she declares upon arrival in Europe
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot has returned to Earth after her spacecraft landed in the Pacific Ocean off California. She spoke to media after arriving in Cologne, Germany.

stories.title: Trump scelle un accord surprise avec Poutine sur le diesel, Zelensky s'indigne

en.title: Trump seals surprise deal with Putin on diesel; Zelensky objects
en.summary: Former President Trump announced an agreement to deliver large quantities of Russian diesel to American and global markets, involving the lifting of sanctions on Moscow. Ukrainian President Zelensky criticized the decision.

stories.title: "Les larmes suivent la pesanteur maintenant" : l'astronaute Sophie Adenot prononce un émouvant discours après son retour sur la terre ferme

en.title: "Tears now follow gravity": astronaut Sophie Adenot delivers emotional speech after returning to solid ground
en.summary: Two days after landing in the Pacific Ocean, French astronaut Sophie Adenot was still unsteady but delivered a speech calling for unity from Cologne airport's tarmac.

stories.title: L'astronaute française Sophie Adenot, de retour sur terre ferme

en.title: French astronaut Sophie Adenot returns to solid ground
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot has returned to Earth after eight months in space, describing experiencing a full range of emotions from joyful to difficult during her mission.

stories.title: Donald Trump s’entend avec Vladimir Poutine pour des livraisons massives de diesel russe, Volodymyr Zelensky s’indigne

en.title: Donald Trump reaches agreement with Vladimir Putin for massive deliveries of Russian diesel, Volodymyr Zelensky protests
en.summary: The U.S. president announced plans to import Russian diesel fuel and lift sanctions against Russia, citing price impacts on Americans ahead of midterm elections, prompting Ukrainian criticism.

stories.title: De retour sur Terre, Sophie Adenot défend «une précieuse planète que nous partageons tous»

en.title: Back on Earth, Sophie Adenot defends "a precious planet that we all share"
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot made her first public appearance after returning to Earth, describing the absence of divisions and borders observed from 400 kilometers altitude.

stories.title: Trump conclut un accord avec Poutine sur le diesel russe, Zelensky dénonce une «horrible» décision

en.title: Trump concludes agreement with Putin on Russian diesel, Zelensky denounces "horrible" decision
en.summary: The U.S. president announced a deal with Russia following what he described as a productive discussion with Vladimir Putin, drawing Ukrainian objections.

stories.title: Ukraine en direct : au moins 11 morts dont trois enfants dans des frappes russes sur Zaporijjia

en.title: Ukraine live: at least 11 dead including three children in Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia
en.summary: Russian airstrikes on the city of Zaporizhzhia in southeastern Ukraine on Saturday morning killed at least eleven people, including three children, according to regional and police authorities.

stories.title: 140 milliards d'euros de coupes : le contre-budget européen de l'Irlande pour débloquer les divergences franco-allemandes

en.title: 140 billion euros in cuts: Ireland's counter-budget for the EU to resolve Franco-German differences
en.summary: Ireland, holding the EU Council presidency, presented a revised 2028-2034 European budget proposal on Saturday, reducing spending by approximately 140 billion euros compared to the initial Brussels proposal in an attempt to reconcile conflicting positions among member states.

stories.title: Trump scelle un accord avec Poutine pour la livraison massive de diesel russe

en.title: Trump seals deal with Putin for massive delivery of Russian diesel
en.summary: Donald Trump announced on Friday that he has negotiated large-scale deliveries of Russian diesel to American and global markets, with sanctions on Moscow being lifted to facilitate the agreement. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned the decision as unworthy.

stories.title: OPINION « Numérique en santé : pas de souveraineté sans filière d’excellence »

en.title: OPINION "Digital healthcare: no sovereignty without an excellence sector"
en.summary: The article argues that France's future in digital healthcare depends on building a competitive, sustainable excellence sector capable of innovation, creating a fair market where French and European offerings can compete globally while ensuring strategic autonomy and quality care.

stories.title: OPINION. « Le 11 octobre doit devenir la Journée internationale des droits des filles »

en.title: OPINION. "October 11 should become the International Day of the Rights of the Girl Child"
en.summary: Representatives from Capital Filles are calling on the United Nations to rename the International Day of the Girl, arguing that this change, backed by French feminist diplomacy, is essential to emphasize that girls' rights are fundamental from childhood for building lasting equality.
